articles.title: U.S. senators urge Treasury not to leave states out of GENIUS Act stablecoin process
articles.snippet: Senators led by Republican Cynthia Lummis are insisting the Treasury Department ensure states get a process to prove their ability to supervise stablecoins.

articles.title: Crypto PAC has $12M stake in Senate primary runoff as Alabama voters head to polls
articles.snippet: Defend American Jobs reported spending $7.4 million on media to support Republican Barry Moore ahead of his May 20 Alabama primary, and an additional $4.7 million before Tuesday’s runoffs.

articles.title: These Bitcoin charts show how BTC price could hit $100K before October
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s double-bottom setup, weekly RSI divergence and whale flows put traders on alert as BTC tests a key breakout zone.

articles.title: Coinbase Gears Up to Launch Tokenized Stock Trading, Crypto and Equities Options
articles.snippet: Publicly traded crypto exchange Coinbase added to its feature set Tuesday as it seeks to become the "everything exchange."

articles.title: SpaceX Shares Hit New High as Elon Musk's Firm Agrees to Acquire AI Startup Cursor for $60 Billion
articles.snippet: The all-stock deal would make Cursor a wholly owned SpaceX subsidiary and deepen the company's push into AI following its blockbuster IPO.
